statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent palpitations and intermittent lightheadedness
The patient has known unspecified atrial fibrillation (I48.91)
The patient has a personal history of transient ischemic attack and cerebral infarction
Mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring (CPT 93229) was billed
The diagnosis codes Z86.73 and I48.91 were submitted
The claim was denied under reason code CO-22
Mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring is clinically necessary to evaluate for arrhythmic burden and optimize anticoagulation management
Continuous ambulatory rhythm monitoring is needed to detect clinically significant arrhythmias that cannot be captured on intermittent evaluation
